children: Hong Kong medical tech firm's half-year revenue rose 6.6% yr/yr, driven by B-Soft acquisition
Company posted net loss attributable to owners, reversing profit from prior year period
Higher expenses and credit losses linked to B-Soft drove swing to loss
ETHK Labs plans to upgrade hospital solution services
Group intends to develop its AI robotics business through collaboration and capital increases
B-SOFT ACQUISITION - Revenue growth was primarily due to consolidation of B-Soft's revenue after acquisition
HIGHER EXPENSES - Increased administrative and research expenses, mainly from B-Soft, contributed to net loss
CREDIT LOSS IMPACT - Higher expected credit loss on receivables also contributed to the swing to net loss
